mutations.name: a fetch mark is created but never advanced, so the run reads as unfetched
kills: gh run fetch marks records a run attempt as fetched, even one with no artifacts, and keeps attempts apart

mutations.name: a repeated ingest archives the record again
mutations.find: if (hasRun(db, run.id)) return { runId: run.id, inserted: false, files: 0 };
kills: ingestRecord writes no second checksum line when a run is ingested again

mutations.name: a pre-header record keeps the run's latest attempt instead of its own
kills: ingestGhArtifact gives a pre-header record a header from the run metadata and the artifact's own attempt and shard
